about.en: SPCXon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (Nasdaq: SPCX), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is fully backed by SPCX shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xc9eEF266834730340A55B6CC24621B31BAF55581, with deployments on BNB Chain, Solana and Robinhood Chain.
